blockers.description: CrewLounge web wizard rejects key canonical headers (TAG_DELAY, TAG_APP, TIME_MODE, FUELPLANNED, INSTRUCTION/TRAINING) — these are in the database schema but not in the wizard's allowed-headers list
blockers.workaround: Use 35-column subset (DELAY instead of TAG_DELAY, etc.)

blockers.description: Wizard requires PILOTLOG_DATE in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD), rejects DD/MM/YYYY even though the export uses DD/MM/YYYY
Wizard flags AC_ENGTYPE='Jet' and 'Turbine (jet-fan)' both as 'Invalid value for Aircraft Engine Type' — actual accepted enum unknown
blockers.workaround: Send anyway; row imports with warning, basic data populates

blockers.description: FLIGHTLOG / JOURNEY LOG appears NOT to persist via cloud — FR8407 export shows FLIGHTLOG empty even though the app shows full JOURNEY LOG content (because FR8407 was imported via native iOS EFB email parser, not wizard)
blockers.workaround: None known — wizard import will leave JOURNEY LOG empty

blockers.description: iOS AirDrop of .csv routes to 'Import Roster Ryanair EFB' handler which rejects CSV with 'Wrong file type for your airline'
blockers.workaround: None for direct CSV. Could potentially replicate EFB email format.

decisions.decision: User always imports via mobile (specifically my.crewlounge.center web), not native PilotLog iOS app's email parser

decisions.decision: Reverted from 99-column canonical schema to 35-column wizard-compatible subset
decisions.rationale: Wizard rejected the canonical headers and DD/MM/YYYY date, making rows fail entirely instead of partially importing.

decisions.decision: DELAY field uses numeric IATA codes pipe-separated for wizard path (not category names which require TAG_DELAY header that wizard rejects)
decisions.rationale: Doc: 'Delay code according to the official IATA code list, e.g. 75 for delay due to aircraft de-icing.'
